findings.text: The launch-failed arm still composes "fix the command and PATH ... then launch a fresh attempt with `reckon crew resume --run <id>" as the row's next_action, so the resume remedy the plan's defect narrative complains about survives on the classifier surface (crew status/recovery status) even though the obligation now names a discard; a reader there is still offered a command resume refuses.

The fragment says the checklist case fails at base because the cause is not printed, but the cited negative-control log (logs/negative-control-base.log, 2 failed, 1 passed) names only the launch case and the acceptance case; the checklist case did not exist when that log ran, so the claim is asserted rather than recorded.
